newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy to propose cutting conscription to 10 months.
newsitem.headline: Italy to propose cutting conscription to 10 months.

text.p: Italy's centre-left government will propose cutting compulsory military service from one year to 10 months in its 1997 deficit-cutting budget package, Defence Minister Beniamino Andreatta said on Monday.
"The ministry has prepared a budget proposal which forsees conscription being reduced to 10 months," Andreatta told reporters after a military ceremony.

The budget package, which aims to cut next year's public sector borrowing requirement by 32.4 trillion lire ($21.43 billion), must be presented to parliament by September 30. Both chambers then have until December 31 to approve it.
Andreatta said the government would ask for funds to offer military personnel vocational training and employment assistance to help them find jobs after they leave the service.
